definitions.gloss: summer heat; hot weather; heat of summer
definitions.explanation: The heat and warmth of summer, or the hot air characteristic of the summer season. A somewhat literary or formal way to refer to summer heat.

examples.japanese: {暑気|しょき}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: To drink beer to beat the summer heat.

examples.japanese: {暑気|しょき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳|きび}しく→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧きた。
examples.english: The summer heat has been getting harsh.

examples.japanese: {暑気|しょき}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{兼|か}ねて→兼ねる：11668_kaneru⟧、⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ビアガーデン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to go to a beer garden with friends, partly to beat the summer heat.

notes: Most commonly appears in the compound {暑気|しょき}⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧ (beating the summer heat — typically through food, drink, or outings), which is a traditional Japanese custom of enjoying cold foods and beverages or gathering with friends during the hottest part of summer. Also seen in {暑気|しょき}⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧ (heatstroke/heat exhaustion — a somewhat old-fashioned term). Homophones: ⟦{初期|しょき}→初期：11742_shoki⟧ (initial stage), ⟦{書記|しょき}→書記：13055_shoki⟧ (secretary) — different words. Related: ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (intense heat — stronger), ⟦{残暑|ざんしょ}→残暑：08559_zansho⟧ (lingering summer heat — after the peak has passed).
